lines.text: Aspen chalets don't rent for just Christmas week.
Five bedrooms in Snowmass. Hot tub in the snow. Room for ten.
The holiday rate: seventy-two thousand a week.
And the minimum stay is fourteen nights: a hundred forty-four thousand.
Ten skiers, one week of lift tickets: about nineteen and a half thousand.
A private chef for two weeks: about twelve thousand, plus food.
Before tips and tax: about a hundred seventy-five thousand dollars.
That's seventeen thousand five hundred a guest. Would you split it?
